## Tailored risk definitions (SUS-RISKDEF-001, proposed)
Table III matrix unchanged. Severity monetary thresholds (4.3.3d):

| Category | Table I minimum loss | Tailored minimum loss |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Catastrophic | $10,000,000 | $100,000 |
| 2 Critical | $1,000,000 | $10,000 |
| 3 Marginal | $100,000 | $1,000 |
| 4 Negligible | $0 | $0 |

Derivation: Table I injury and environmental criteria unchanged. Monetary thresholds scaled by 1/100 because Table I values ($100K/$1M/$10M) exceed the total value of a simulation-and-bench demonstrator and would place all equipment loss in Negligible.

Probability basis (4.3.3e): per item over the planned demonstrator life; item life walker operating hours 500, docking cycles 2000, uav flight hours 200; bands A >= 1e-1, B < 1e-1 and >= 1e-2, C < 1e-2 and >= 1e-3, D < 1e-3 and >= 1e-6, E < 1e-6, F eliminated.
